title: Group and count
prompt: Implement `static Dictionary<string, int> CountByFirstLetter(IEnumerable<string> words)` — group words by `char.ToLowerInvariant(word[0])` as key; and `static Dictionary<int, int> CountByLength(IEnumerable<string> words)` — group by length. Null/empty input → empty dictionaries.

tests.name: normal
tests.hint: GroupBy the normalized key, then ToDictionary(g => g.Key, g => g.Count()).

tests.name: edges
tests.hint: Both null and empty normalize to empty dictionaries.
